desc: Owns project and build-level work for Compose and Compose Multiplatform apps: bootstrapping a new project, adopting the kit in an existing project, adding or extracting a module, convention plugins in build-logic, the version catalog, and CI plus agent hooks. Use when starting a Compose Multiplatform app, adding a module, or editing settings.gradle.kts, build.gradle.kts, build-logic, libs.versions.toml, or packaging.
